zh: 我很忙，也很累。
en: I am busy, and I am tired.

zh: 你冷吗？ - 不，我很热。
en: Are you cold? No, I am hot.

zh: 他好吗？- 不是，他很坏。
en: Is he good? No, he is bad.

zh: 我们是学生，你是老师。
en: We are students, you are a teacher.

zh: 他们是同事吗？- 不是，他们是室友。
en: Are they colleagues? No, they are roommates.

zh: 你不是我的朋友。你是我的老板。
en: You are not my friend. You are my boss.

zh: 老师忙吗？- 是的，他非常忙。
en: Is the teacher busy? Yes, he is very busy.

zh: 你的同事在哪里？ - 他不在这里。他在日本。
en: Where is your colleague? He is not here. He is in Japan.

zh: 他们来自中国吗? - 不是。他们来自韩国。
en: Are they from China? No. They are from Korea.

zh: 我的手机在哪里？ - 它在你的包里面。
en: Where is my phone? It is in your bag.

zh: 他们是谁？ - 他们是我的同事。他们是很好的人。
en: Who are they? They are my colleagues. They are very good people.

zh: 你的公司在哪里？ - 它不在这里。它现在在越南。
en: Where is your company? It is not here. It is in Vietnam now.

zh: 这是你的书吗？-不是，这不是我的书。我的书在我的包。
en: Is this your book? No, this is not my book. My book is in my bag.

zh: 他的爸爸在哪里？ - 他在公司。他很忙。
en: Where is his father? He is in the company. He is busy.

zh: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？- 我最喜欢粉色。
en: What is your favorite color? My favorite color is pink.

zh: 我们的老板今天不在办公室。
en: Our boss is not in the office today.

zh: 你住在这里附近吗？ - 不是。我家离这儿很远。
en: Do you live near here? No. My home is far from here.

zh: 你喜欢什么颜色？ - 我喜欢粉红色和灰色。
en: What color do you like? I like pink and grey.

zh: 他们说西班牙语吗？- 不是，他们说意大利语。
en: Do they speak Spanish? No, they speak Italian.

zh: 我们现在去公司还是学校？ - 我们去公司。
en: Do we go to the company or the school now? We go to the company.

zh: 我不喜欢我们的老板。他今天不在办公室。
en: I don't like our boss. He is not in the office today.

zh: 你听什么音乐？ - 我听流行音乐。
en: What music do you listen to? I listen to pop music.

zh: 学生们学习中国历史和中文。
en: The students study Chinese history and Chinese.

zh: 你要喝咖啡还是绿茶? - 我不喝咖啡，也不喝茶。我喝水。
en: Do you want coffee or green tea? I don't drink coffee or tea. I drink water.

zh: 你在哪里工作？- 我在一家公司工作。
en: Where do you work? I work in a company.

zh: 你在学校里看书吗? - 不看，因为我们没有时间。
en: Do you read books at school? No, because we don't have time.

zh: 我没有笔，老师。- 别担心，我给你一支笔。
en: I don't have a pen, teacher. Don't worry, I give you a pen.

zh: 你几点起床？ - 我每天七点起床。
en: What time do you get up? I get up at seven o'clock every day.

zh: 你早餐吃什么？ - 我早餐吃面包和鸡蛋。
en: What do you have for breakfast? I have bread and eggs for breakfast.

zh: 你周末做什么？ - 我周末去购物中心。
en: What do you do at the weekend? I go to the shopping center at the weekend.

zh: 你不可以在医院用手机。
en: You can't use your phone in the hospital.

zh: 你为什么不能开你的车？- 因为我没有车。
en: Why can't you drive your car? Because I don't have a car.

zh: 明天是我的生日聚会。你可以来吗？
en: Tomorrow is my birthday party. Can you come?

zh: 你会游泳吗？- 我男朋友会游泳。他在海滩教我。
en: Can you swim? My boyfriend can swim. He teaches me at the beach.

zh: 请问，我可以坐在这里吗？- 不好意思，我的孩子们要坐在这里。
en: Excuse me, can I sit here? Sorry, my children want to sit here.

zh: 你的老板有孩子吗？- 当然没有。
en: Does your boss have children? Of course not.

zh: 你男朋友在餐厅工作吗？
en: Does your boyfriend work in a restaurant?

zh: 你的狗吃什么？ - 我的狗只吃肉。
en: What does your dog eat? My dog only eats meat.

zh: 你的父母住在哪里？ - 我妈妈住在一个大城市，我爸爸住在一个小村庄。
en: Where do your parents live? My mother lives in a big city. My father lives in a small village.

zh: 你多久去一次健身房？- 我经常去健身房。
en: How often do you go to the gym? I often go to the gym.

zh: 你喜欢你的工作吗？为什么？
en: Do you like your job? Why?

zh: 你怎么放松？ - 我在周末见朋友。
en: How do you relax? I meet friends at the weekend.

zh: 你更喜欢夏天还是冬天？ - 我更喜欢夏天，因为天气很好。
en: Do you prefer summer or winter? I prefer summer because the weather is nice.

zh: 你可以在这里抽烟吗？- 不可以，但你可以在那里抽烟。
en: Can you smoke here? No, you can't, but you can smoke there.

zh: 他的妻子很高，也很漂亮，也很年轻。
en: His wife is tall, beautiful, and young.

zh: 我觉得，我的房间很小。我只有两个椅子和一张桌子。
en: I think my room is small. I only have two chairs and one table.

zh: 你最喜欢的菜是什么？- 我喜欢鸡肉和牛肉。
en: What is your favorite food? I like chicken and beef.

zh: 我们很不同。他很高，我很矮。
en: We are different. He is tall, I am short.

zh: 你有空的时候，喜欢做什么？- 我喜欢做饭。
en: What do you like doing in your free time? I like cooking.

zh: 你的儿子喜欢做什么？- 他很享受画画。
en: What does your son like doing? He enjoys drawing.

zh: 我真的讨厌做饭。我比较喜欢开车。
en: I really hate cooking. I prefer driving.

zh: 昨天天气很冷，所以我在家。
en: Yesterday the weather was cold, so I was at home.

zh: 你去年在哪里？ - 我在西班牙度假。
en: Where were you last year? I was on holiday in Spain.

zh: 我的老板昨天不在办公室。
en: My boss was not in the office yesterday.

zh: 你的室友以前住在哪里？
en: Where did your roommate live before?

zh: 你昨天上午做了什么？ - 我做了一些家务，然后看了一部电影。
en: What did you do yesterday morning? I did some housework, and then I watched a movie.

zh: 你的火车几点到了伦敦? – 下午3点就到了。
en: What time did your train arrive in London? It arrived at 3 pm.

zh: 不好意思，我又迟到了！你等了我很久吗？
en: Sorry, I am late again! Did you wait for me a long time?

zh: 你弟弟在大学学了什么? – 他学了政治。
en: What did your brother study at university? He studied politics.

zh: 去年我和一些朋友去了墨西哥。
en: Last year I went to Mexico with some friends.

zh: 你昨天买了新的手机吗？- 没有，商店里没有了。
en: Did you buy a new phone yesterday? No, the shop didn't have one.

zh: 你什么时候到马尼拉的？
en: When did you arrive in Manila?

zh: 你小时候玩很多电脑游戏吗？
en: Did you play a lot of computer games when you were young?

zh: 上周我丢了我的手机。
en: Last week I lost my phone.

zh: 你告诉了他吗？ - 我告诉了他，但是他没明白。
en: Did you tell him? I told him, but he didn't understand.

zh: 昨天我起得很早，然后做了早餐。
en: Yesterday I got up early, and then I made breakfast.

zh: 你什么时候学会说英语的？
en: When did you learn to speak English?

zh: 谁杀了他？我不知道。
en: Who killed him? I don't know.

zh: 你办公室附近有酒吧吗？
en: Is there a bar near your office?

zh: 我家附近没有酒吧。
en: There isn't a bar near my house.

zh: 你的包里有什么？ - 包里有一部手机和一本书。
en: What is in your bag? There is a phone and a book in the bag.

zh: 冰箱里有鸡蛋吗？ - 没有鸡蛋，但是有牛奶。
en: Are there any eggs in the fridge? There are no eggs, but there is some milk.

zh: 这个世界上有很多好人，也有一些坏人。
en: There are many good people in the world, and there are some bad people too.

zh: 你的新房子有几个卧室？ - 有三个卧室，两个浴室。
en: How many bedrooms does your new house have? There are three bedrooms and two bathrooms.

zh: 你的公寓附近有河吗？
en: Is there a river near your flat?

zh: 火车上有很多人吗？- 是的，火车很满，没有空座位。
en: Were there many people on the train? Yes, the train was full. There were no empty seats.

zh: 客厅里有电视和钢琴。
en: There is a television and a piano in the living room.

zh: 我的公寓里没有冰箱！
en: There isn't a fridge in my flat!

zh: 那个女人是谁？她是做什么工作的？她从事房地产工作。
en: Who is that woman? What does she do? She works in property.

zh: 昨天晚上你家里有人吗？
en: Was there anyone in your house last night?
